questions.enonce_markdown: Solve the inequality $-2(5-x)\leq 4-5x$ and represent your solution on a real number line. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Expand the left-hand side: $-10 + 2x \leq 4 - 5x$.

Collect the $x$ terms on the left and the numbers on the right: $2x + 5x \leq 4 + 10$, so $7x \leq 14$.

Divide by $7$ (positive, so the inequality sign is unchanged): $x \leq 2$.

**Number line:** draw a horizontal line marked with integers (for example from $-3$ to $4$). Put a **closed (filled) circle at $2$**, because $2$ is included in the solution, and draw a thick line with an arrow from $2$ to the **left**, towards $-\infty$.

**Solution: $x\leq 2$.**
